meta.name: cascade-fail-recovery
meta.description: Handle cascading data retrieval tool failures by falling back to embedded knowledge generation

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动降级处理数据检索失败，改用内置知识生成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果数据检索工具经常失败，需要自动恢复机制
copy.tagline_en: Automatically fall back to embedded knowledge when data retrieval fails
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your data retrieval tools often fail and you need automatic recovery

howto.what: 当连续两次数据获取工具（如读取网页、搜索网页）失败时，Claude会立即使用内置知识生成内容，而不是放弃任务或反复重试。它会保留原始目标，生成文档并标注哪些信息未经外部验证。
howto.when: 当连续两次或更多次数据获取工具（如读取网页、搜索网页）失败（如网络错误、超时）时触发。

say.text: 如果连续两次读取网页失败，就用你的知识生成内容。
say.note: 触发回退机制，跳过外部源。

say.text: 搜索工具都不可用，直接根据知识写一份报告。
say.note: Claude会使用内置知识生成文档。

howto.what_en: After two consecutive data retrieval tool failures (e.g., read_webpage, search_web), Claude immediately falls back to generating content from embedded knowledge instead of aborting or retrying. It preserves the original objective, produces a document, and notes any unverified information.
howto.when_en: Triggered after 2+ consecutive failures of data retrieval tools (e.g., read_webpage, search_web) due to network errors or timeouts.

say_en.text: If two consecutive webpage reads fail, generate from your knowledge.
Search tools are all down; write a report from your knowledge.
say_en.note: Claude produces a document using internal knowledge.
